sandbachFocus: Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to extend their excellent recent form. The league leaders are currently 1st with 22 points from 10 games and have won their last four matches, demonstrating impressive consistency. Alsager Town arrive in 19th place with just 4 points and are struggling badly, having lost their last five matches, making this a heavily favoured fixture for the home side.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a key fixture that could see them close the gap on Sandbach; Stafford have drawn their most recent match but remain very much in contention. AFC Bridgnorth (3rd) host Eccleshall (5th) in an intriguing mid-table clash where both sides have shown recent promise—Bridgnorth bounced back from a loss with a win, while Eccleshall are seeking to recover from a recent defeat. Wolverhampton Casuals face Wednesfield Community in a local derby between two competitive sides; Casuals have won their last outing while Wednesfield have shown inconsistency. New Mills visit Market Drayton Town in a fixture between two sides battling mid-table—New Mills are on a difficult run of losses while Market Drayton have won three of their last four. Bilston Town (6th) host Foley Meir (13th) in a match featuring one of the division's in-form sides against a struggling outfit; Bilston won last time out and remain a strong outfit. Barnton welcome Shawbury United in a clash between two sides near the lower reaches; Barnton won their last match while Shawbury are enduring a poor run with five consecutive losses. Crewe host Allscott Heath in a fixture between two of the division's weaker performers, while Widnes Town visit Brereton Social as the away side continue to struggle at the bottom of the table. Cheadle Heath Nomads face Telford Town in a bottom-half encounter where both clubs have recorded draws recently but desperately need victories.
